mechanism_narrative: The four-week climb in TRANSIT from -68.9 to -64.7 percent shows commuting capacity is returning, which raises weekday retail-and-recreation footfall; therefore RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT improves again over the next four weeks while RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES recovery from -66.3 at t-2w to -60.4 at t-0w indicates more workers leaving home for jobs, and this office return lifts nearby retail demand, so RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays above -60.0 and RETAIL_REC falls or stays flat over the next 14 days, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A policy easing that pushes GROCERY_PHARM above -20.0 percent signals essential-trip normalization and reduced hoarding, freeing household budgets for discretionary visits; RETAIL_REC then rises over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM rises above -20.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not exceed its prior 14-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility drops below 40.0 percent change from baseline, residents are spending more time outside the home on non-essential trips, which directly lifts RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 40.0 percent change from baseline.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL is below 40.0 and RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than its last 7-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES jointly improving week-on-week creates a commuting-retail complementarity: more station entries accompany more office attendance, and both jointly pull RETAIL_REC up over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve week-on-week for two consecutive weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve for two weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the last 28 days, reject.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS recovery above -64.0 while RESIDENTIAL remains above 38.0 signals outdoor recreation replacing indoor retail trips, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks despite overall reopening.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -64.0 and RESIDENTIAL stays above 38.0.
failure_condition: If PARKS rises above -64.0 and RESIDENTIAL stays above 38.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than its last 14-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, RESIDENTIAL above 40.0 and WORKPLACES below -62.0 indicate renewed stay-home orders and office closures, which suppress RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL > 40.0 and WORKPLACES < -62.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than its last 14-day mean, reject.

mechanism_narrative: Precautionary grocery stocking, shown by GROCERY_PHARM staying above -21.0 while RETAIL_REC remains below -63.0, signals that households still avoid discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays above -21.0 and RETAIL_REC stays below -63.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than the last 28 days, reject.
